result.summary: The page looks generally functional with one notable visual issue found.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel is truncated mid-word (cut off at 'Piccol' instead of showing the full name, e.g., 'Trattoria Piccolo'). Unlike a card that is intentionally partially visible to hint at scrollability, this card appears to be a fully visible card whose text label is clipped by the screen edge without any visual indication that the name continues.
issues.suggestion: Ensure that text labels beneath restaurant cards either truncate with an ellipsis ('...') or that the card layout accounts for the full name width. If the card is meant to be partially off-screen, the truncation of text should still be handled gracefully with an ellipsis rather than a hard clip.
